comments.content: The ternary operator `asset.fileModifiedAt < asset.fileCreatedAt ? asset.fileModifiedAt : asset.fileCreatedAt` will throw a TypeError if either date is null/undefined. Add null checks or use optional chaining. Consider: `const earliestDate = [asset.fileCreatedAt, asset.fileModifiedAt].filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => a - b)[0] ?? new Date();`

The `getDates` method is called but not shown in the diff. Ensure it handles null/undefined dates from tags and asset properties safely, and returns a consistent shape with `dateTimeOriginal`, `modifyDate`, and `localDateTime` properties.
